shared_elements: vertical band/column of stylized plant ornament
alternating repeated floral units in a column
low-relief carving with outlined, ridged detail
justification: Both surfaces contain the same distinctive ornamental motif: a vertical stem bearing alternating rosettes and palmette fans with curling volutes, rendered in shallow relief with the same ridged, outlined petal conventions — in A this fills the flanking borders, in B it occupies the whole field. The decisive difference is that A's field is dominated by a large winged anthropomorphic figure in profile carrying a bucket and cone, an element wholly absent from B, which is purely vegetal ornament.
